class Importer
{
    public function run(array $rows): array

            return $this->normalise($row);

        $joined = new \DateTimeImmutable($row['joined']);

final class Paths
{
    public static function join(string ...$parts): string
    {
        return '/' . implode('/', self::clean($parts));
    }

    private static function clean(array $parts): array
    {
        $clean = [];
        foreach ($parts as $p) {
            $p = trim($p, '/');
            if ($p !== '') {
                $clean[] = $p;
            }
        }
        return $clean;
    }
}
